import('@get-h3/h3-harness-sdk')                 → Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND] (exit 1)
import('@get-h3/h3-harness-sdk/examples/basic.js') → Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND] (exit 1)

**2. After fix — Node runtime checks (in-package):**

root import by name        → OK @get-h3/h3-harness-sdk 1.0.0 (+ default export object)
./examples/basic.js        → OK {center, ring[6], total: 7}

TypeScript `NodeNext` typecheck from the consumer passes via the `types` condition for the root *and* `./examples/*.js` (`.d.ts` resolved correctly; runtime unaffected).
